policy.summary: Codex receives reusable engineering workflows that do not require Claude-only product integrations. Native Agent Skills are the sole Codex parity surface; legacy /prompts adapters are retired.
policy.include: Development, quality, maintenance, review, and repository workflows that operate from the checked-out project and documented CLI/MCP capabilities.
policy.exclude: Claude-only content and idea workflows that depend on unavailable product integrations or are intentionally provider-specific. An exclusion must be recorded here before it is omitted from the manifest.
